CURRENT SCENE:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

ITEMS:

[I176] 【神农】和他的家人住在古代   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 神农: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: 这是一个⟦神农⟧的古代故事 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦神农⟧住在一个中国小镇 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦很久以前，在古代⟧有一个叫神农的老人 — her note: “很久以前“ and ”在古代” are redundant, only keep one

[I177] 神农和他的家人【住】在古代   correction: 住 → 生活   strength: error
  checker's note: 生活在古代 is needed for living in a historical era
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦神农⟧住在一个中国小镇 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦很久以前，在古代⟧有一个叫神农的老人 — her note: “很久以前“ and ”在古代” are redundant, only keep one
  her past correction: 神农回[-他的]家 — her note: redundant

[I178] 因为他的家人常常生病【了】   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: habitual action with 常常 does not take 了
  rule card (no_le_routine_state, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): For a routine, habit, repeated condition, or state, use zero particle: do not add 了completed. This is especially true with words such as 老是, 常常, and 从早到晚.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this describes a routine/habit or repeated condition, so use no 了 (no了for routine/habit).  Her terms: no了for routine/habit, no了for habit/routine, 看look vs.看到see, no了
  her past correction: 因为他们常常生病[-了] — her note: no了for routine/habit
  her past correction: 他们常常生病[-了] — her note: no了for routine/habit
  her past correction: [+他]就生病了 — her note: otherwise it is ambiguous who gets sick

[I179] 他们去【^】很多不一样的地方   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: error
  checker's note: a completed action in this narrative normally needs 了
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他们搬到[+了]城市 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 快要死[+了]
  her past correction: 他尝[+了]很多植物 — her note: 了completed

items.explanation: This character appears for the first time, so please introduce 神农 briefly, for example as a person in an ancient story.
Use 生活在古代 for living in a historical era. 住 is usually used for living in a specific place.
This describes a routine or repeated condition with 常常, so use no 了 for routine/habit.
Going to many places is completed in the story, so it takes 了 completed.
